print(ctl.spend.mean().round(2))
# 46.9
print(trt.spend.mean().round(2))
# 46.74
t = stats.ttest_ind(trt.spend,
        ctl.spend, equal_var=False)
print(round(t.pvalue, 3))   # 0.88
# bootstrap 95% CI for the difference:
# [-2.16  1.99]
caption: No evidence of a spend effect.

code:
r = stats.linregress(
    df.prior_sessions, df.spend)
print(round(r.slope, 2))      # 3.6
print(round(r.intercept, 2))  # 25.13
print(round(r.rvalue**2, 3))  # 0.053
caption: +$3.60 per prior session; association, not cause.
